prompt: Photograph of an architect's presentation model on a dark green self-healing cutting mat. Three identical tiny white model towns, each on its own round white card disc, stand in a row that recedes into soft focus. Each town has small houses, a shop street and a bank with columns, built from clean white foamboard and museum card with crisp knife-cut edges. In the nearest town exactly one small house is bright cutter-yellow. A few tiny scale-model figures of a man in a navy suit walk the streets. Three-quarter elevated view. Soft north-window daylight from the upper left, gentle soft shadows on the mat, tilt-shift shallow depth of field, studio product photography. The mat is plain deep green with only a very faint fine grid. No text, no numbers, no logos, no hands, no tools.
